Maya Patel: Quick sync — need to confirm SLO math before we send the monthly report to NovaHealth. They asked about latency SLO (p95 = 250ms) and uptime credits. Who can validate the numbers?
Sam Ortiz: I ran the export earlier. p95 around 220ms on the dedicated cluster for Feb, uptime ~99.93%. But our credits calc in billing seems to use a slightly different exclusion set than legal's table.
Elena Wu: I can validate. @Maya can you confirm billing period and whether we should exclude scheduled maintenance?
Maya Patel: Period is 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28. We had one scheduled maintenance 2026-02-18 for ~30m. Legal confirmed scheduled maints are 'excused downtime'.
Kyle Johnson: FYI credit tiers we use: <99.0% => 10% credit, 99.0%–99.9% => 5%, >=99.9% => 0. Make sure you use uptime = (total_time - downtime_excl_excused) / total_time when computing.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance recorded (ID: maint-238) — window 2026-02-18 02:00–02:30 UTC.
Elena Wu: Quick calc: total period = 28 days = 672h (or 604800s). Excluding 30m => uptime = (604800 - 1800) / 604800 = 0.9999706 -> 99.99706% (rounds to 99.997%). Wait, double-check hours math: using calendar days it's 720h if counted as full month slot, but our standard is exact days in interval. Using the 28d window the uptime is 99.97% which is above 99.9 => no credit. p95 = 220ms < 250ms SLO.
Sam Ortiz: Can you paste the exact query you used so I can reproduce and attach for the customer?
Elena Wu: Sure — snippet I used in observability: 
```
-- uptime calc (pseudo-SQL)
SELECT
  1.0 - SUM(downtime_seconds)/SUM(period_seconds) AS uptime
FROM internal.uptime_events
WHERE period_start >= '2026-02-01'
  AND period_end <= '2026-02-28'
  AND downtime_reason NOT IN ('scheduled_maint')
```
And p95 pulled from `redwood.metrics.p95_latency{cluster="dedicated-nova"}`.
Maya Patel: Perfect. For the customer-facing package: one-paragraph summary, csv export attached, and a short worked example showing the uptime math and why no credit is due. I'll draft and send by EOD. @Sam please include renewal/health note — customer mentioned higher latency during onboarding ramp.
Sam Ortiz: On it. I'll add a renewal risk flag and propose a 1:1 with infra next week to run through tuning options during peak traffic.
Kyle Johnson: I'll prepare a 1-pager of quick lever recommendations (batching knobs, quant profiles, max_batch_wait adjustments) that we can share in the 1:1. Low-effort items first.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks — Elena, can you drop the exported CSV into this thread so I can attach it to the message?
Elena Wu: Uploaded -> `novahealth-feb2026-slo-export.csv` (internal link).
ops-bot: audit-bot: export stored at /cs-exports/novahealth/2026-02.csv.
Maya Patel: Awesome — closing loop. I'll post the drafted report in #customer-success and send final to the account. If anything changes on the math, I'll ping.
